name: T02
source:
theorem T02 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M
  unfold Scope.Model.modeDet Scope.Model.S Scope.Model.detJ
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.modeDet N M = m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 - m.S * N * M + m.detJ * M ^ 2

author: shared-a1
name: Q01
source:
theorem Q01 : ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c := by
  intro a b c x ha hb
  have h1 := Int.sq_nonneg (2*a*x+b)
  have e : 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) = (2*a*x+b)^2 + (4*a*c - b^2) := by grind
  have h2 : 0 ≤ 4*a*(a*x^2+b*x+c) := by
    rw [e]
    omega
  have h3 : 0 < 4*a := by omega
  exact Int.nonneg_of_mul_nonneg_right h2 h3
statement: ∀ (a b c x : Int), 0 < a → b ^ 2 ≤ 4 * a * c → 0 ≤ a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c

author: shared-a2
name: T03
source:
theorem T03 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0 := by
  intro m N M h hu hv hM hN
  unfold Scope.Model.trJ at h
  unfold Scope.Model.modeTr
  have h1 : (m.a + m.d) * M < 0 := Int.mul_neg_of_neg_of_pos h hM
  have h2 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du + m.Dv) := Int.mul_nonneg hN (by omega)
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeTr N M < 0

author: shared-a1
name: T05
source:
theorem T05 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M hd hM hN h hDD
  rw [T02]
  have h1 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h hN
  have h2 : 0 < M * M := Int.mul_pos hM hM
  have h3 : 0 < m.detJ * (M * M) := Int.mul_pos hd h2
  have e1 : M ^ 2 = M * M := by
    rw [show (2:Nat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one]
  have e2 : N ^ 2 = N * N := by
    rw [show (2:Nat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one]
  rw [e1, e2]
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → 0 < m.modeDet N M

author: shared-a2
name: T06
source:
theorem T06 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5
  rw [T02] at h5
  have e : M ^ 2 = M * M := by grind
  have hM2 : 0 < M ^ 2 := by rw [e]; exact Int.mul_pos h2 h2
  have hM : 0 < m.detJ * M ^ 2 := Int.mul_pos h1 hM2
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h7 : m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h8 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M := Int.sub_nonneg.mpr h7
  have h6 : 0 ≤ N * (m.Du * m.Dv * N - m.S * M) := Int.mul_nonneg h3 h8
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.Du * m.Dv * N < m.S * M

author: shared-a0
name: T04
source:
theorem T04 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S := by
  intro m N M hdet hDu hDv hM hN hneg
  rw [T02] at hneg
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have hS : 0 ≤ -m.S := by omega
  have sq : ∀ x : Int, x ^ 2 = x * x := by
    intro x
    first
      | grind
      | rw [show (2:Nat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one]
  have hN2 : 0 ≤ N^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_nonneg hN hN
    rw [sq]; exact this
  have hM2 : 0 < M^2 := by
    have := Int.mul_pos hM hM
    rw [sq]; exact this
  have h1 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N^2 :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg (by omega) (by omega)) hN2
  have h2 : 0 ≤ -m.S * N * M :=
    Int.mul_nonneg (Int.mul_nonneg hS hN) (by omega)
  have h3 : 0 < m.detJ * M^2 := Int.mul_pos hdet hM2
  have e : -m.S * N * M = -(m.S * N * M) := by
    rw [Int.neg_mul, Int.neg_mul]
  rw [e] at h2
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S

theorem H01 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.hamGain r₁ B C ≤ Scope.hamGain r₂ B C := by

author: shared-a2
name: T08
source:
theorem T08 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M := by
  intro m N M ha h
  rw [T02]
  have h2 : m.S ^ 2 * M ^ 2 ≤ (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ) * M ^ 2 :=
    Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h (Int.sq_nonneg M)
  have h3 : (-(m.S * M)) ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * (m.detJ * M ^ 2) := by
    have e1 : (-(m.S * M)) ^ 2 = m.S ^ 2 * M ^ 2 := by grind
    have e2 : 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * (m.detJ * M ^ 2) = (4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ) * M ^ 2 := by grind
    rw [e1, e2]; exact h2
  have h4 := Q01 (m.Du * m.Dv) (-(m.S * M)) (m.detJ * M ^ 2) N ha h3
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.Du * m.Dv → m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ → 0 ≤ m.modeDet N M

name: H04

theorem H04 : ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁ := by
  intro r B C₁ C₂ h hf
  unfold Scope.Favoured Scope.hamGain at *
  omega
statement: ∀ (r B C₁ C₂ : Int), C₁ ≤ C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₂ → Scope.Favoured r B C₁

name: H03
source:
theorem H03 : ∀ (r₁ r₂ B C : Int), r₁ ≤ r₂ → 0 ≤ B → Scope.Favoured r₁ B C → Scope.Favoured r₂ B C := by
  intro r₁ r₂ B C h1 hB hf
  have := H01 r₁ r₂ B C h1 hB
  unfold Scope.Favoured at *
  omega

author: shared-a1
name: T07
source:
theorem T07 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) := by
  intro m p s hd hp hD hS n hn
  have sqe : ∀ x : Int, x^2 = x*x := by
    intro x
    simp [Int.pow_succ]
  have hn1 : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int) := by omega
  have hq : (1:Int) ≤ (n:Int)^2 := by
    rw [sqe]
    have := Int.mul_le_mul hn1 hn1 (by omega) (by omega)
    simpa using this
  have hs2 : 0 ≤ s^2 := Int.sq_nonneg s
  have hk : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 := Int.mul_nonneg hD hs2
  have h : 0 ≤ (m.Du * m.Dv * s^2) * ((n:Int)^2 - 1) :=
    Int.mul_nonneg hk (by omega)
  have h2 : m.Du * m.Dv * s^2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    grind
  have hM : 0 < Scope.modeM p := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    rw [sqe]
    exact Int.mul_pos hp hp
  have hN : 0 ≤ Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeN
    exact Int.mul_nonneg (Int.sq_nonneg _) hs2
  have h3 : m.S * Scope.modeM p ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * Scope.modeN s n := by
    unfold Scope.modeM
    exact Int.le_trans hS h2
  exact Int.le_of_lt (T05 m _ _ hd hM hN h3 hD)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.S * p ^ 2 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 → ∀ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n → 0 ≤ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p)

author: shared-a1
name: T09
source:
theorem T09 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2 := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6
  refine ⟨T04 m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6, ?_⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h7 : m.S ^ 2 ≤ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h8 := T08 m N M (Int.mul_pos h2 h3) h7
  omega
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.modeDet N M < 0 → 0 < m.S ∧ 4 * (m.Du * m.Dv) * m.detJ < m.S ^ 2

author: shared-a1
name: T12
source:
theorem T12 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M) := by
  intro m N M h1 h2 h3 h4 h5 h6 h7
  exact ⟨T03 m N M h1 h3 h4 h5 h6, T05 m N M h2 h5 h6 h7 (Int.mul_nonneg (Int.le_of_lt h3) (Int.le_of_lt h4))⟩
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), m.trJ < 0 → 0 < m.detJ → 0 < m.Du → 0 < m.Dv → 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → m.S * M ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N → Scope.Hurwitz (m.modeTr N M) (m.modeDet N M)

author: shared-a0
name: T11
source:
theorem T11 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2 := by
  intro m p s h1 h2 h3 ⟨n, hn, hd⟩
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro h
  have h4 := Int.not_lt.mp h
  have h5 := T07 m p s h1 h2 h3 h4 n hn
  exact absurd hd (Int.not_lt.mpr h5)
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (p s : Int), 0 < m.detJ → 0 < p → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → (∃ n : Nat, 1 ≤ n ∧ m.modeDet (Scope.modeN s n) (Scope.modeM p) < 0) → m.Du * m.Dv * s ^ 2 < m.S * p ^ 2

author: shared-a2
name: T10
source:
theorem T10 : ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N := by
  intro m N M hM hN hD h
  rw [T02] at h
  apply Classical.byContradiction
  intro hc
  have h2 : m.S * N ≤ m.detJ * M := Int.not_lt.mp hc
  have h3 := Int.mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h2 (Int.le_of_lt hM)
  have h4 : 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv * N ^ 2 := Int.mul_nonneg hD (Int.sq_nonneg N)
  have hM2 : M ^ 2 = M * M := by
    first
      | grind
      | simp [Int.pow_succ]
      | (rw [show (2:Nat) = 1 + 1 from rfl, Int.pow_succ, Int.pow_one])
  have h5 : m.detJ * M ^ 2 = m.detJ * M * M := by
    rw [hM2, Int.mul_assoc]
  grind
statement: ∀ (m : Scope.Model) (N M : Int), 0 < M → 0 ≤ N → 0 ≤ m.Du * m.Dv → m.modeDet N M < 0 → m.detJ * M < m.S * N
